Title: LSJ - Sudario Refraction and Freak Drive

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
Hello all,

if I play Sudario Refraction and one of the cards chosen is a Freak
Drive, can I use that Freak Drive to untap or has the action already
ended by the time I replace my three cards?

My guess is no but just checking to make sure.

Thanks,

Archie

Messages.Author: Alex Ek
Messages.Body:
Archibald Zimonyi skrev:


Freak drive is played after resolving the action.
Resolving Sudario in this case means drawing a Freak drive.
In my book that means you can us it.
Regards
Alex

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:

Gah, I answered my own question incorrectly. The no part was in
reference to the action having ended, i.e. I too think I can use the
Freak Drive.
